# Video to Image Sequence Online
> Free, 100% private, browser-based video frame extraction and image sequence conversion suite.

## Core Capabilities
- Extract high-resolution PNG & JPG frames from MP4, MOV, and WEBM videos.
- 100% client-side processing using WebAssembly, Web Workers, and HTML5 Canvas API.
- Zero server uploads — video files never leave the user's computer.
- In-browser AI Social Media Frame Picker automatically scores video keyframes on sharpness, motion blur, exposure, composition, and face/eye detection.
- Convert PNG/JPG image sequences back into WebM video files.
